Name: Ashley Allen
Badge: Reading to Write: They Say / I Say
Which version of the They Say / I Say routine (with visual texts or with annotation) feels like the best fit for your students right now? Why?:

They Say/ I Say through Annotation is what I think will best benefit my students at this time. We have been working heavily on this for the past few months and while they are getting better, they still need more improvement. Annotating test can be extremely beneficial during classwork and testing.

Describe one way you might adapt the They Say / I Say framework to align with the types of texts your students read most often (e.g., articles, visuals, multimodal texts).:

I could do this by having students restate the main idea or key concept. They could do so by stating, "The textbook explains that..." followed by, "This leads me to think that...".

What, if anything, do you need help thinking through as you plan for using They Say / I Say in your classroom?:

I don't think that I need help with any of it at this time. I feel like I have a good plan developed to begin implementing this routine in my classroom.
